takeaways: High-value Microsoft consultants sell the reduction of architectural entropy across identity, productivity and infrastructure control planes, not apps and migrations.
A paid three-plane assessment creates the baseline and risk report that leads into remediation engagements and recurring advisory retainers.
Position against the cost of inaction, such as breaches, failed audits and failed migrations, instead of competing on hourly rates.
hook: Many Microsoft 365 consultants are stuck selling hours, apps and migrations in a market that keeps pushing prices down. This episode is for consultants, architects and IT professionals who want to build a premium practice around governance and risk reduction. You get a framework for assessments, pricing tiers, client acquisition and a 12-month plan.
